entities.summary: Connor Murphy is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for the Edmonton Oilers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected 20th overall in the 2011 NHL entry draft by the Phoenix Coyotes, and has also played in the NHL for the Chicago Blackhawks. He is the son of former NHL defenseman Gord Murphy.
